t:
Do you know that each Thread is spun, then woven into the Pattern, then cut?

When the end of a Gibberling's path comes, the deceased is committed to flames. Cut off from the common carpet by the clan's Thread Keepers, the remainder of their unused thread is put into the palms of the deceased.

Before Yok destroyed the sea, it was customary to scatter the ashes over water, and especially revered representatives of the people were sent on their last voyage in a small boat which was set on fire by a shot from a distance.

Now no one wants to send the ashes of their dead to the unknown and frightening abyss of Ginnungagap!

This is how the Stone Boats appeared - the outlines of the ships that you see here laid out on the ground with rocks. Inside the boat, the ashes of members of the same clan are buried, and their names are written on the stones that form the sides. This is how the old forgotten tradition of the "family ship" is preserved, and the deceased get the opportunity to go with their family on a happy "endless journey".

And what happens to your people when your Thread breaks?

I'm not going to judge you, even though I believe that every Thread has its own length, and attempts to lengthen it are pointless. You can't escape your destiny. But it's up to you... Don't let the Darkness deceive you.

We searched for ancestors together,

We found the right news.

I know where we need to go,

We will find everything there... without deceit!
Zvik, zvik! I remember how the history of the Gibberlings began, how Ase and Emla stood here, how settlements began to grow, and more and more people came to the Great Ash Tree...

Curious! When Num created the peoples, he gave each of them something of their own. Long-eared Elves got the ability to feel beauty, the Orcs had rage, the Dwarves - hard work, the Zvergs - understanding of their native elements, the Trolls - thoroughness, the Pridens - courage, and the Gibberlings - curiosity. Even as they grow old, they remain childlike at heart, and Ase and Emla were the same.

Zvik, zvik! They never ceased to be amazed at everything they saw. It is good that their descendants did not lose this gift.

Zvik, zvik! The First were given a long life for a reason. Each of us was the keeper of their inheritance - the Ash Tree and the forests of Isa were mine. The squirrels collect the fruits of the trees and store them so that some of them can sprout in their own time.
Oohhh! It's so scary and so interesting! Of course!

We have long dreamed of finding the missing part of the sprout. Even on Coldberg, when our first brother died, we wondered if someone else might become our brother... I hope Sigurd will not be offended!

Emla performed the first ritual without knowing it. When she was braiding hair, she wove the Threads of her first children into strong patterns. The mystery of weaving is hidden from me, but I know that it is possible. The Threads of your friends sound in unison. This will be a strong union.
Brother! Eh… I was kind of hoping for something else… Well, alright, there are other beautiful Gibberlings on Isa, and anyone would be lucky to have a sister like Gerda!

I only saw it once when I was little. I tried to perform it on myself afterwards, but it didn't work. I'm too old to weave my Thread with someone else's. But Gerda, Wickham, and Trondur are still young enough, so everything will work out. I will teach the Thread Keepers how to do it.

Only a Weaver can weave threads together. Unn said that you are a Weaver, but this ritual requires not only a Weaver's power, but also the knowledge of how it is performed. We ourselves have never done it, but I think remembering the precepts of our predecessors can help us figure it out. Go talk to them and find out if they are ready!

Our walk to the mountains took a long time!

It was a miracle we didn't freeze!

The deceptive bear

Sent us in the wrong direction!

But we still made it

There was a cave,

With a forgotten ship

The captain was my... ancestor.

And after learning

What really happened

I found my brothers

They had been with me!

We hit the treacherous Urun

Working as a team,

And the chief of all the Orcs

Was not allowed to rise again!

And I have already started composing the finale!

This will be a masterpiece!
Yes, Koll's story made me very sad - how he disappeared and apparently stayed here on Isa! But at least we found Gerda. And that means it wasn't all in vain!
Zvik, zvik, little Gibberlings. Have you really found each other?
I never dreamed we would actually find relatives here on Isa!
Now that's what I'm talking about - the story as it was, and not how someone decided it should be.
I'm glad everyone's having fun, but honestly, I'm kind of worried. Kharyskhan almost killed us all, and now I have the responsibility of making Isa a part of the world again... a part of Sarnaut!

I'm glad you believe in me. I would like to think that my new brothers will help me. But... it's also difficult! I have always been alone. I don’t know what a real sister should do! Besides, we are so different… Out there, outside of Isa, many believe in the light and have the ability to resurrect, and we know that the Thread of every being is finite. What will happen to our sprout, then?

I'm glad you're willing to help! I would like to think that my new brothers will help me. But... it's also difficult! I have always been alone. I don’t know what a real sister should do! Besides, we are so different… Out there, outside of Isa, many believe in the light and have the ability to resurrect, and we know that the Thread of every being is finite. What will happen to our sprout, then?
If you believe that everything will be alright, then I guess it probably will be.
It's pretty amazing! Is it possible to go against fate? Or perhaps fate provides for that? I wish I knew for sure!
Good. I wouldn't want to be alone again! Life is easier with brothers!
Well, I guess I'll find out sooner or later! I need to be brave, because there are so many dangerous things in the world!

Oh! I've almost finished it! Here:

There were three of them now:

Trondur, Wickham, and Gerda!

Thread Keepers are with them,

They are ready to help with the Tree.

The ritual was performed

The dark spell was lifted

The tree blossomed again

Isa was saved!

Now we can go

On a journey

A ship was built

By a Gibberling family.

Their path lies

Through the Void which is boundless

Many things await them

And endless adventures!

Brave brothers

Their sister with a harp

Has become a great skald

Everyone knows her now!

Do you think it will come true?

I'm glad you think so! So it really will!

Can we sit here a little longer?

Yes, Gibberling bards will have their say some day!

Can we sit here a little longer?

In the middle of the night, when the feast was in full swing, enemies broke into the city!

The Urun came from mountain burrows, Sabertooths came from the forest, Werebears sailed across the sea and flooded the harbor, and a Jotunn almost broke down the gate when he came out of the forest!

Everyone who could not fight fled from the city to the harbor. Styr prepares a boat to help people escape.

And I... I'm holding on with all my might and waiting for you!

Kharyskhan grabbed Gerda and the Sharps and rushed off in the direction of the Ash Tree. Murk followed him.

I'm afraid it might be too late!

The spinners of all the clans gathered under the Ash Tree, preparing the ritual of weaving Threads. Nothing can awaken them from this trance, and now they are under Kharyskhan's control...

Hurry, ! Get the children out of Skalgard, Styr has the boat ready in the harbor!

And then go straight to the Ash Tree!

I'll get there as soon as I can... Don't ask me how, you'll see!

...! Brother!Sister!

You should have seen them! There were so many!

I'll stay here for a bit before I go into battle again... And you should go now. The path is clear!
The Hall of Fates is open!

I gave birth to many deities. There are those among them who found the meaning of their existence in the fight against Darkness. Far from Sarnaut and Eden, in the darkness of the void between the worlds, a shining beacon burns - Enod, the World of Light. I will give you an understanding of how to contact it. The rest is up to you. Only you.

Oh! I didn't even believe it existed... Until last night.

The Hall of Fate is a place where our mind is cleansed of everything material. It sees only an endless canvas of Threads in front of us. There, the strength of the Weaver is increased many times over... And the Ash Tree is the gate that leads there.

No wonder our people have defended the Ash Tree for thousands of years at the cost of their lives. You yourself saw what can happen if this power was in the hands of the enemy.

And I also heard that an unprepared mind may suffer after visiting the Hall!

Are you feeling well?

We were testing a new boom gun! And then we hear that Isa was discovered! Of course, we immediately sailed to the Frozen Frontier - and our people were already packing up their things there. Sorry we missed all the fun. They say it was quite a mess here! But that's fine... We need to help the locals now - they are clearly well behind the times. We are just figuring out where we can place some cannons here...

So this is our lost homeland! Yes, the place is harsh and fiercely cold, and there are many beasts of all kinds! But we're going to live here, looking for all sorts of exciting stuff... Soon there'll be more Gravestein people here, the place is gonna be cramped! That's why we need to move on!

Well, we're glad the Urun are finished! They are finished, right? We think we won't see Kharyskhan on Isa again. And the rest of the problems are easy to overcome. Yes, and there'll be way more people here. Look how many have arrived...

Yes, we should repair everything the Urun destroyed in the village. And the guests need to be welcomed properly. If we survive all this, then, perhaps, we can fly out to visit them. They say the Gibberlings have enough settlements outside Isa. We would like to see how they live out there. And of course, to determine who is the strongest. Here we were the best, and out there... well, we need to know!

There you are!

We don't know what you did there with this Kharyskhan, but as soon as he disappeared, the Urun lost all their fighting spirit. They all froze as one, ears pressed to the head, hissing!

We drove them away from the city then! Along with their tame cats and bears. It will be a while before they stick their noses out of their caves again.

Yes! Unbelievable! Have they finally found the homeland of the Gibberlings? And we've given up hope since you broughtyou broughtyou broughtthe heroes of the League broughtthe heroes of the League broughtthe heroes of the League broughtthe heroes of the League broughtthe heroes of the League brought the news that the Eyepopping Family had found the ruined Isa. Apparently, when Koll's Threads were torn, no one could find it, seeing only mirages in the astral...

It's a pity that my brothers did not see Isa!

She is arguing with me again! What Urun are you talking about, you stupid woman! You should worry about the Werebears! It's rightly said that they are neither man nor beast! The weight is what matters. Paw span. The size of the teeth. And cats... are nothing serious. May our Priden friends forgive me...

We're wondering what's the biggest threat for the Winter Watch. We also want to defend it. And even though there are only two of us.... maybe we can connect our Threads to someone? To Ella, for example? I feel sorry for her brothers, the Wing-Footed, but she’s a skilled girl… Unless… she and Vicky join forces against me! So there's something to think about.

I didn't believe Isa would ever be found! We kinda got used to this idea - that's why we began to build a new house on the Frozen Frontier. And then everything changed again. Now it takes some getting used to. And, of course, all sorts of questions arise. Do you remember that the Gibberlings joined the League to find Isa? Many will now ask - why do we need the League? But I don't think we should leave it so quickly.

I want to see all of Isa, of course. I heard so much about it, and now I can explore it myself! Then we need to inform all the Gibberlings about it, and then we will confer - both the Gibberlings who lived outside Isa and the locals - how we should live now and what we will do. Perhaps they will decide to choose a new elder - it's quite possible, yes! Also, I want to check how the Great Trees are doing now. As long as there is peace everywhere, this is possible...
Wow... This is Isa? I can't even believe it, to be honest!

Wow… there's so much here! We had no idea what Isa would be like! And it's just so... wow! The Gibberlings will not fear anyone now - neither the Empire nor the League! We've only just managed to get out of Igsh - there were no captured Leaguers left. We were the last. We almost got used to captivity...

There are only two things that are worth something. It's great puzzles and great treasures! Do you think there are any treasures here on Isa? My brother and sister and I believe there must be! You've found something already, but there are probably piles somewhere! Of treasures. After all, our ancestors once brought a lot of things to Isa!

Oh, it's a pity my brothers won't see it! They would have been so happy... But that's fine! Now no one will think they can take Isa from us! This is the birthplace of the Gibberlings, and it will remain so. We have the means to protect it, and people like me - experienced warriors - will be happy to help the locals! I see they weren't born yesterday either, even though their methods of war... are somewhat rusty? But we will help them - do not doubt it!

Don't listen to Indie - we are not going to plunder everything here. There are other islands for this! But they could use our help - after all, there are remote places on Isa that even the local trackers avoid. We are thinking of heading for this Bear Ridge! See what's out there...

Oh, hello! Familiar faces! When we heard about it in Novograd, we immediately sailed to the Frozen Frontier, and then here. Is it really Isa? I just can't believe it!

Now I just need to keep an eye on my little sister! Or she will run off again, and I'll have to look for her...

Oh, hello, hello! Yes, it's great here! And this mead is fantastic! If only we had it when we went to Ferris...

You know, after all, sometimes treasures are not gold and precious stones, but such simple things like the recipe for this mead! Of course, we won’t tell anyone about it, but we can have a little mead, hehe.

True Gibberlings don't take the easy road! We are always drawn to places no rational being would want to go. And there must be a lot of such places on Isa! We just need to make preparations beforehand. We survived on the Cold Isle, didn't we? We did! Although I had to eat one troll... So what? It was a bit tough, but not tougher than horse meat.

But I think here we will find common ground with the locals! Seekers also want to explore the uncharted places! In short, we'll finish this mead and start packing.

We saved the Great Ash Tree, which is worth a lot! I hope this Great Tree will awaken the other First ones. You have seen some here on Isa, but many more are still dormant. In time, under the influence of the Ash Tree's power, they too will be able to awaken...

First of all, zvik-zvik, I want to pay the debt! I'm talking about the spirits of Howlem - Ekhe-Hoor, Sakhyl, Makchirgue, and Tooraah, who sacrificed their power so that we could get to Isa. They didn't die, no. They just gave their all. I think together with Muninn and Huginn we will figure out how to get it back.
Zvik, zvik! You saved the Great Tree after all! This is just wonderful, although I did not doubt you...

Ah, greetings! Remember me? And I remember! You saved me! My brothers and I decided to split for the time being. I'm on Isa now, and they'll break the news to the others. We must visit Ingos - there are many of our people there!

I'm afraid it will be hard to keep this a secret! But Isa belongs to the Gibberlings! I think we'll manage.
Hi! And I'm not lost! As you can see, I'm sitting here with my brothers, chatting with the locals! Life is very different here on Isa and in Novograd!

Right... Well, there is nothing better than pleasant surprises, even though they promise a lot of trouble!

Isa was found, and that's what matters. Of course, in terms of profits... Perhaps there is nothing particularly valuable here. No meteorite, no June ruins. Isa is worth something only to the Gibberlings. Therefore, it's most likely safe. After all, everyone now has other things to worry about. And we have time to prepare!

Ohoho!

Remember how we were Remember how we were Remember how we were Do you have any idea how long we'd been Do you have any idea how long we'd been Do you have any idea how long we'd been Do you have any idea how long we'd been Do you have any idea how long we'd been getting reports that they couldn't find Isa? So much effort was put into the search. And now, when all hope was lost, it happened!

Now what? It's not clear... Who will lead the Gibberlings? How will their relationship with the League change? It's not at all clear. It's possible that soon our duties will be changed!

Oh, Isa! I also dreamed of finding it and, together with my sisters, spent more than a year of my life searching! It was because of these searches that I, at one time, ended up on Evermeet Isle...

Yes, I heard about Koll and Freya. The brave captain set an example for us. An example of never giving up. After all, we thought that Koll never found it... he just vanished... Do you know how many captains never returned? I could have been one of them.

Well, then... That would have been my fate... Although, knowing how it turned out later, can I really complain?

Hello. Once upon a time, I wondered what Isa would be like... After all, we no idea. We had nothing but old legends to go on.

And now here, on the shore of the remnants of the sea, I see that it's exactly the same as it was in my dreams...

Halsten, brother...

I know you're here somewhere... Where could you be if not here? And Gertrude is near a Stalwart somewhere...

Of course, you made it here. How could it be otherwise... I knew. We'd meet in the shade of the Ash Tree, I told them... Right...

Wow, look at that!

Nice, nice! And here we are looking at how everything is organized by the locals! You see, a Gibberling will not leave a Gibberling in trouble! And maybe they are missing something. And we could deliver it to them on the Sparrow...

We can do it quickly, too. But they seem to be doing alright.

No, would you listen to that! Why Werebears? Urun! The Urun are the most dangerous! Even without this Kharyskhan!

Werebears are stupid and clumsy. Before one reaches you, you can turn him into a hedgehog... The Urun are a different matter! You won't even hear it before it jumps you! And the Pridens - everyone knows they are great hunters. And the Urun are like upgraded Pridens! Hundreds of years of selection! Ugh, that's creepy.

Yes, we are wondering who should be feared on the Winter Watch! What kind of Gibberlings would we be without this tradition? We'll be the first from the outside world, except for the Sharp family, to do it. However, there are three Sharp members now, so we'd also need a third one!

You, maybe? Haha!You, maybe? Haha!You, maybe? Haha!You, maybe? Haha!You, maybe? Haha!You, maybe? Haha!You, maybe? Haha!Maybe you can lend us one of yours, haha!

Buddy! I'm glad to see you. While we were flying to Isa, everyone was talking about you.  is amazing, people said. HeShe fulfilled the age-old dream of our people! But it makes me wonder... there are so many of us Gibberlings all over the Astral! What will happen if everyone comes here? Chamomile will definitely get lost in such a crowd! Someone needs to think about this...

We want to speak with those Gibberlings that have been separated from Isa for a long time. They have their own history, quite a dramatic one, and it is time to weave our history and theirs together. I am also concerned over the fate of the New Isa. I am sure that even though Isa has been found, they should not abandon this undertaking. The treaty with the dragon Nordrak may also be important to all of us. After all, Dragons and Trees are part of the whole.

Not the way I expected, but even better! Here:

Suddenly the Urun attacked

The village at night,

Evil Kharyskhan

Wants to bind Fates.

New family:

Gerda, Trondur, and Wickham

Became his victims.

But don't you cry now!

Our great hero,

In the halls of fate

Tied all the Threads together

And the family is safe!

It's incredible! But perhaps this was our destiny? Who really knows if it was preordained or not? Everyone will decide for themselves. I think Kharyskhan… I mean Skulnar also thinks that's the way it should be!

I would love to go on a Great Journey! To visit every piece of this vast world! But my brothers and I will probably stay on Isa for now. We need to defend the Winter Watch! Now, together, we can do it!

Ahhh! A real flying ship! On Isa!

Ahhh!

Oh, look, we're all united now! It's so strange! And so amazing!

There you go!

Are you an Orc? I've never seen Orcs, even though I know what they look like... but the war between us is long over, so I hope you won't make a fuss. You won't, will you? And we, the children of the sea, help everyone in times of need.Wow, an actual Priden. I have heard of you, though I have never seen one. You don't really look like Urun. I know that our peoples once drove out the Orcs... I hope you remember that friendship, too. And we, the children of the sea, help everyone in times of need.Of course, I haven’t seen people like you before, but we, the children of the sea, help everyone in times of need.Of course, I haven’t seen people like you before, but we, the children of the sea, help everyone in times of need.Of course, I haven’t seen people like you before, but we, the children of the sea, help everyone in times of need.Of course, I haven’t seen people like you before, but we, the children of the sea, help everyone in times of need.Of course, I haven’t seen people like you before, but we, the children of the sea, help everyone in times of need.I see you are also Gibberlings, although not from around here. But I am glad to see lost relatives, very glad. We, the children of the sea, help everyone in times of need.

Gerda shouldn't have been there in the first place, my friend!

We guard the road to the south coast. The spinners told no one to go there.

We don't, and no one else should.

What is this Watch? Gerda's? Uh-oh...

Only families can keep watch. If the Gibberling is completely alone, they must join another family. Youngsters must not be alone, especially on the Watch!

Nobody sent the girl anywhere, I'll tell you that. Apparently she was upset they didn’t take her, so she ran away. She does that. Stubborn like her grandmother!
Yo-ho-ho, don't be silly, my friend. What Lyngbakr ate is lost forever. I swear by my only sister, no one has managed to catch this beast yet, and I will not go near it again!
Oh-oh-oh... Oh dear! How could it be...!
Wow, I'll be damned! I didn't expect him to call me again after that incident...

If the Elder wants to do it, then I'm in! Catching this fish is my old dream! What can we say - every fisherman in our village would love that... Of course, you can't catch healthy fish without good bait!

When cold winds blow, only your own fur can save you!

Are you an Orc? I've never seen an Orc before! Only heard of them.You're like the Urun, just black!Aren't you cold without fur?Aren't you cold without fur?Aren't you cold without fur?Aren't you cold without fur?Aren't you cold without fur?Hello, kin! Do you also eat fish back home or do you prefer something else?

A questionable undertaking...

When we got together last time, the weather was exactly the same... This is not good, I said then. Prophetic words! Everything went wrong: the wind blew in the wrong direction, and the sea was raging... I hope it doesn't mean another misfortune is coming...

If we don't want to freeze in the middle of the harbor - we all need to get warm! And I'm not talking about strong drinks! There are better, old-fashioned ways! These waters will turn anyone into ice if you don't do as I say...

Well, let's go I guess...

The old Styr made up his mind? I told him - we must avenge Jon! The damned fish must pay for your brother's death with its life! But he was afraid... and of what! This Lyngbakr is nothing like the old ones - they say my ancestor caught a fish so huge that it took a whole day to get from the head to the tail!
Catching Lyngbakr is a glorious feat, so I'm in!
Are there fish where you come from? And big ones? Bigger than that skeleton on the roof over there?

Well, you have your whole life ahead of you! Fishing is not just catching fish, it's a way of life! You just need to start! It's not that important whether you catch big or small fish, many at a time or just one. What matters is fishing itself! If it gives you pleasure - you are a real fisherman!

What's this Winter Resort? Like the Winter Watch, is it? Oh, I would love to visit other lands and fish there! Just imagine all the different ponds out there - there must be some kind of fish in them. Ahh, I wish...

Fish is not biting.

Hey, you Orc face, don't stomp around here! You'll scare away all the fish!Hey, you Urun muzzle, stop wagging your tail! You'll scare away all the fish!I don't know who you are and you smell weird! I hope you don't scare away all the fish!I don't know who you are and you smell weird! I hope you don't scare away all the fish!I don't know who you are and you smell weird! I hope you don't scare away all the fish!I don't know who you are and you smell weird! I hope you don't scare away all the fish!I don't know who you are and you smell weird! I hope you don't scare away the fish!Well, fellow Gibberlings, don't scare away the fish! Hush, the three of you are too loud...

Wow! But Styr said he would never go out to sea again! He blamed us for the death of his brother… Like, if we had rowed better, and thrown the harpoon more accurately, then everything would have been fine… But who is really to blame? Maybe it's Fate.

But I believe that our destiny is to catch this fish!
I'm all for it, let's get this Lyngbakr! It's been a while since we all got together!

Damn people everywhere, scaring away the fish.

Hey Orc, can you fish? Can you beat at the water with those hands to stun all the fish? Ahaha!Hey, you with the long tail - can you catch fish with it? Ahaha!You, bare-skinned one - can you catch a fish or will you freeze right away?You, bare-skinned one - can you catch a fish or will you freeze right away?You, bare-skinned one - can you catch a fish or will you freeze right away?You, bare-skinned one - can you catch a fish or will you freeze right away?You, bare-skinned one - can you catch a fish or will you freeze right away?What kind of fisherman are you, buddy? Are you a real Gibberling or just a poser?

Eh, what's this about?

I know Styr misses his brother... But you won't bring Jon back by killing Lyngbakr...

Jon, what a pity... Once upon a time we loved each other, and no one knew the sea as well as we did. No one... And we dreamed of adventures... But everything was lost after this hunt for Lyngbakr!

I don't believe we can do anything right now... without Jon...
Well, if Styr really wants to get everyone back together... I'll come with you. It we manage it, we'll avenge Jon, and if we don't - then I'll die just like him.

Think about it: we are trapped on our small island, and once upon a time a boundless space was open to us. The Gibberlings traveled the world on their boats, going to places no one else would go. Jon and I also secretly dreamed that someday we'd be able to travel to other lands... and while we understood that these were empty thoughts, we still imagined ourselves as ancient wanderers who lived before Yok... Eh...

Eh, it's dust and ashes now...

And now some Orc is here...And now some black Urun is here...And now there's a creature I've never seen before...And now there's a creature I've never seen before...And now there's a creature I've never seen before...And now there's a creature I've never seen before...And now there's a creature I've never seen before...And now some Gibberlings show up, and they are clearly not from around here...

When he mounts the one awakened by the power of four, will the fish rider save a friend who has suffered unfairly? Even though they are black and not white? The maiden who begged the captive - will she awaken the source of the gifts? Gifts for those who are shepherded by the horned one above the underground fire?

You're new here, so let's repeat the lesson!

No nets can be made this week. And watch your gear so it doesn't get tangled. Now is such a fateful time. Every knot you tie affects your path in the world.

Therefore, only us Spinners are allowed to spin and weave today.

All right, go now! Your eyes tell us you understood everything.
Where would you like to go?

Can you tell me later how it goes? Yes?

Oh, I can't wait!

I would really, really love to, but...

You know, luck doesn't like me at all. If I go with you, the boat will definitely be swallowed by a monster. I can't even swim, remember?

You go, and I will ask Emla to hold your Threads tighter.

Good luck!
It’s a pity that Jon is not with us… I really want him to see it too…
Wow, it's been a while since Styr and I sailed out... Those were glorious days...
The abyss awaits its prey in vain!
Oh, if we succeed, what kind of stories are we going to tell?! Everyone will envy us!

Ugh, no!

You forgot the Bear Grease. Use fresh one - it will last longer!

If you fall into the water, you will instantly turn into ice.

Be quick, the whole team is waiting for you!
Sagas will be written about this day!

First and foremost, don't fall into the water! If you do, you'll die!

Second - the skin on the back of this beast is terribly tough! The only weak point is at the fin on the back, but it's really hard to hit it from afar. So we will strike it in the side or the belly. Wait for the fish to jump out of the water, then throw the harpoon right at the belly!

Third is... ruff knows what! We'll see how it goes! The Spinners said the hunt would be successful - so it would be successful!

Well, sea cadet, are you ready?!

This is the fish of my... our dreams! It's huge!

Brother Jon should have seen this…
Because… it was flapping its fins really fast?
I knew it! I knew from the very beginning that we would succeed!

I can't believe you caught it! I've already started writing a song about it!

Here, listen:

The mighty hero defeated Lyngbakr,

And cut through a thousand morays!

Their brave ship sliced through the waves,

Thus my amulet was returned!

So what do you think?

Yes! Yes! It's my amulet!

Thank you! Thank you!

Eww, now it stinks...
Yes, I knew it! I think someday I will tell a real saga about your arrival! After all, this is just the beginning!
Oh, it's no big deal! Do you know what's the most important thing in sagas? To please the audience!

Zvik-zvik, where do you think? Here, on Isa!

Well... I didn't think you'd be scattered all over the place like that...

But I hadn't used Vegvisir magic for a very long time, so my jump... was a little inaccurate.

Zvik, zvik...

The spirits of the bear, fox, owl and raven are still with me. Their power sustains me... Now it depends on you whether their sacrifice was in vain.
Damn my fingers are itching! I really want to punch someone!
What does the blind eye not see?
It's not a simple as it seems! Be careful with the bees...
Bees are not something to take lightly. Bees are serious business, I'm telling you.

Hmm... You want to know what it is? And you can't guess what the keeper of flame can give you for the fire mead?

Here, the Fire Essence - that's what you need for the mead to truly warm the blood! Take it and keep it safe. Tell the Gibberlings that I wish them victory. Kharyskhan is an enemy to us all.

As for these harmful spirits, don't worry. I'll handle it. I'll send them beyond the mountain range.
Well, as my grandfather - Hazen the White was his name - used to say: Let's brew already!

We came here from the Frozen Frontier... from New… Isa…

You may have heard that we Gibberlings are building a new home in this icy land, not far from the Kanian Archipelago.

The Great Dragon Nordrak, who is still encased in ice, is helping us with this. The ice gradually recedes. The cause is the sapling of the Great Tree that we received in Darkwater.

There is great power in the Great Trees. They are capable of destroying an age-old glacier... or turning a desert into a garden, like here in the Dead Sea which, I am sure, will sooner or later become a Living Land. But… that is if the Great Trees survive. But when the All-Mother was captured, it began to wither...

It took Froddy tremendous effort to obtain the sprout! How we grieved when we discovered that Isa had died… New Isa became our great hope, and now…

I don't know which side you were on and what you fought for. But this is no longer important - we all suffered from the actions of these deities of Darkness. That is why I am here in your world. Perhaps this is where we can deal with the Darkness.

But now grief has seized all the worlds. The All-Mother is the source of our strength, the strength of Life itself and Creation. Without her, existence is doomed... The Great Trees begin to weaken and die. There is a sense of decline even in Eden.

You fought bravely for us, and I can't blame you for anything. It was the All-Mother's choice to go to Sarnaut, which means it was fated to happen. The Children remember your sacrifices and will always come to the rescue. That is why I am here in your world. Perhaps this is where we can deal with the Darkness.

But now grief has seized all the worlds. The All-Mother is the source of our strength, the strength of Life itself and Creation. Without her, existence is doomed... The Great Trees begin to weaken and die. There is a sense of decline even in Eden.

Well, I remember your choice and that you fought against us. However, while my kin demand vengeance, I do not share their views. Perhaps, despite whatever divides us, we all need to find a compromise. That is why I am here in your world. Perhaps this is where we can deal with the Darkness.

But now grief has seized all the worlds. The All-Mother is the source of our strength, the strength of Life itself and Creation. Without her, existence is doomed... The Great Trees begin to weaken and die. There is a sense of decline even in Eden.
I thought badly about the Empire for a long time, but seeing how you planted the sprout of your Great Tree here, I believe not everything is lost for you.

Our people put so much effort into the construction of New Isa... It is scary to imagine what labors and resources went into the development of these ice islands.

But we had no other choice. Yes, Kania gave us Ingos, but plenty of other creatures live there. The Forestfolk, Wormfaces, and even human hunters that don’t want to leave.

And our numbers are growing. It's been a long time since we left the distant island where we'd lived after the loss of Isa. There are a hundred times more of us now. Is there a land we can call home?

But our ancestors were also looking for Isa! One brave captain from a family of our distant great-grandfathers sailed across thirty-three astral seas on his ship, the Freya, without any visors and reactors! He dreamed of finding our home. He did not know it had been destroyed. He disappeared somewhere in the depths.

The decay of the Trees is caused by the imprisonment of the All-Mother. Great power is in the hands of this goddess who became the mother of all living things.

Know that I saw how a battle once took place near our world. The All-Mother met the one you know as the Sculptor. He was then an emissary of the Architect, a sower of soulless Order. But his ship was torn apart by the power of the Trees, the power of the All-Mother.

And its fragments fell on the surface of Sarnaut, and three Guardian Dragons perished. But along with the largest fragment, seeds also fell on our world.

In the area where the ship crashed in the ocean, an island arose, and the island became Isa. And the first Great Tree grew from those seeds, and it was the same Great Ash Tree that gave birth to Ase and Emla.

Years passed, and the fruits of the Ash Tree were transported by wanderers to other parts of the world. And they gave birth to new Great Trees, each Great in its own way. All of them are now linked together.
Hello! I didn't think I'd meet you on the Kanian Archipelago of all places, but shared misfortunes force people to act.

It's so nice to be here, next to this ancient Great Tree. The Kanians did well planting it here...

So be it. Now be quiet and stop thinking!
So be it. Now be quiet and stop thinking!

The First are our hope! Once upon a time there were many more of them, now only four are with us - the mighty Ekhe-Hoor, the cunning Sakhyl, the wise Makchirgue, and the freedom-loving Tooraah! Of the rest, alas, only a memory remains - like those visions in the grove of the First.

I remember the ancient lands of Isa when Howlem was part of it. Many of the First roamed these parts, serving as patrons of mortals. Among them was Heldig, my bear brother… but I remember others, too – the mighty boar Iofur, the whale Khvalur who was as big as an island… There were many of them, and they all sacrificed themselves to save our land.

Remember me. Until we are forgotten, we are alive... I have wanted to hibernate for a while now.

It's amazing to see the ancient power of the Pridens. Once upon a time, when the world was whole, our peoples were great. They formed an alliance against the Orcs in order to expel them from Isa. Before us is the legacy of those times.

You are a child of the Orc people. But we don't hold it against you. You are far from the deeds of your ancestors, and the Horde is long gone from this world.The Gibberlings have a vague memory of what happened. Only fragments of legends remain from those times, but it is good that the Pridens also keep that memory. I hope you keep it, too.We Gibberlings owe it to the Pridens. Remember this, my little brethren. They are now on our side, like in the old times.Although you do not share the history that connected the Pridens, Gibberlings, and Orcs, you should remember it and draw a lesson from it.Although you do not share the history that connected the Pridens, Gibberlings, and Orcs, you should remember it and draw a lesson from it.Although you do not share the history that connected the Pridens, Gibberlings, and Orcs, you should remember it and draw a lesson from it.Although you do not share the history that connected the Pridens, Gibberlings, and Orcs, you should remember it and draw a lesson from it.Although you do not share the history that connected the Pridens, Gibberlings, and Orcs, you should remember it and draw a lesson from it.

Many of the First were on Isa at one time. They were powerful patron spirits who helped not just the Pridens, but also the Gibberlings, and other peoples on Isa.

Alas, Yok spared no one. Of the First, most gave their power to Howlem to save it. Only four remained, and you can see them with your own eyes.

But, those who are not here now did not die for good. Giving up their power, they fell into a deep sleep.

I feel the Threads of their Fates inside the Great Tree. It was the seed of this Tree they gave power to, and now I can reach them.

But I can't do it without your help...

Remember: the sleeping spirits gave all their power to the Tree. So I need power to wake them up.
How long was I asleep? Interesting... Zvik, zvik.

Once upon a time, the world was torn apart. The Great Nothing began to devour everything!

When the void was approaching the shelter of the survivors, the Pridens and their Voices called to us, the First! We split the earth and raised the mountain range called Howlem away from Isa. I was instructed to bring an Ash Tree seed so that a new Tree could be planted in order to save this people! Then we gave our powers to the Tree... and fell into a long sleep.

If the Pridens' Primordial Tree is in danger, then the Ash Tree is, too! We must hurry...

That's nonsense!

The Great Ash Tree is able to hold the Great Nothing, just like the First Tree holds this mountainous region called Howlem. This means that Isa, or at least the lands around the Ash, also survived.

I would go there... but I'm not strong enough...
I feel sorry for the old raven... But Ash's fate is more important than our fates.

Zvik, zvik! Sorry, little friends, but after a thousand years of sleep, I am not strong enough to take you to a selected part of Isa.

I'll look for you as soon as I have enough strength for a new flight.

Oh, my beauty! My darling!

I'm talking about the boat, don't get any ideas now!

The first time I see a real hermit!

I wonder why she's here? Did my great-great-great people also live in these places?

She must know something about them!

I know, I know... We are forbidden to chat with the exiles, and they - with us.

I don't understand why. They can tell us so much about their adventures in the wilds...

But we'll think of something!
[Lyrra points inquiringly at the keg of Fire Mead and the bundle of firewood.]

[Lyrra shakes her head.]

You already have too much mead on you. Lyrra needs the mead more.
[Lyrra reluctantly parts with the mead and takes the bundle of firewood from you.]

You do not have enough firewood for this exchange.

Lyrra will not give you a discount - her living conditions are too harsh.
[Lyrra readily hands you a bundle of frozen deadwood and takes a cup of mead.]
You don't have a drop of Fire Mead to offer Lyrra in exchange for firewood.
[The hermit covers her mouth with a mitten and shakes her head vigorously.]

Those who are no longer needed by their people!

Yor faithfully served old Beorn, but he betrayed our tribe. The white cats returned, and Beorn sold his people to them in exchange for promises...

This is a false path. Yor challenged the leader, as custom dictates. Yor fought for the truth but lost. Beorn laughed at Yor when he threw him off a cliff before he could die in battle.

Yor can no longer hunt. Yor would have been food for white cats if little Lyrra had not brought you.

Speak, outlander. How can Yor repay his debt?

Vain search, outlander.

The hermits of the Ash Tree quickly perish in these lands, and their traces are forever buried by a blizzard. The age of the bear is not great enough to remember that far back.
[The hermits look at your company in surprise.]
[Two Gibberlings hug the third brother tightly.]
[The hermits sadly contemplate the Ash Tree in the distance.]
[The hermits point to a keg of mead and a bundle of firewood.]
[The hermits nod briefly in gratitude and rub their cold paws.]
[The hermits glumly hand over the firewood, but the smell of fire mead makes them smile.]
I'm so angry at this bear!
Well, uh... Maybe you can collect more firewood, and then we will trade?
Don't be greedy, ! You already have three whole cups of Fire Mead.
If you have a cup of Fire Mead, I will happily trade with you!

We leave the island which belongs to the elves of the Grandeur clan and continue our search.

The discovery has caused dismay in our ranks - many of the other captains, like Eric, believe that we need to form a temporary alliance with these people and take advantage of their hospitality for a while - until we find Isa.

But I have doubts - there are few of us, and judging by what we have learned, there are many of those outlanders. Can we remain free? Or will we be forced to reveal our secret? Will we become soldiers of foreign wars?

We can always come back later. In the meantime, we'll keep going and see where the currents in the Great Nothing take us.

Unbelievable! The Orcs, our old enemies, also survived. And we met them here, on the Izune allod. As far as I understand, the Orcs were in the same position - except for the fact that Izune was their homeland, and so they did not need to look for it. But like us, they are just pieces on someone else's chessboard. Some time ago, their ruler, the supreme shaman Rodogor, made a deal with the Empire that guaranteed the survival of their race in alliance with a human nation, the Xadaganians. Perhaps such a fate awaits us? I'd rather it did not.

The Orcs are hostile. They seem to think we're some type of goblins, so they're trying to enslave us. We need to gather supplies before we move on, but I'm afraid it won't be easy.

We've been in captivity for almost a month now. Is this our Fate? Eric says we should stay on the allod of the Grandeur clan, Glock suggests waiting for the Xadaganians and trying to negotiate with them by revealing the secret of our ships to them. But I'm afraid they'll figure it out anyway when they search the ship.

The Orcs are crude animals. They treat goblins like slaves, and it looks like we will be treated the same way. I'm glad they were banished from Isa at some point. They say that Brus, the current supreme shaman and Rodogor's son, comes from the Northwind clan, the one we defeated on Isa.

Brus is acting strangely. He forbade the Orcs from boarding our ship. He is waiting for something - but what? The Xadaganians? Maybe. They say the Empire has its ways of loosening tongues.

Something incredible happened today. I finally met this Brus. He is smarter than he looks. Certainly smarter than his henchmen. Brus demanded that I come alone, and we had a long discussion. Nobody needs to know what he told me. I will write it down in my journal for now.

Brus wants us to find their ancient leader. For some reason, he believes he is somehow alive. Skulnar the Northwind, the Bane of Humans - after the Orcs were expelled from Isa, his clan led the Orc people and tried to conquer the world. Skulnar was killed, but his body was retrieved and sent to Isa!

Brus offers a deal. A magic oath. He will let us go, and I will find Skulnar. And Isa. I'm not sure. I don't know what to do.

Failure again! The Kanians are after the secret of our ships! Nobody can be trusted. Eric says we should negotiate - we can demand land from Kania in exchange for the secret, and Glock thinks that Xadagan can offer us more.

But they don't understand: we must find our homeland, Isa!

Nobody knows there's a way to find it. What Brus gave me is still with me. If I fulfill my oath, then we can find our homeland.

I spoke to my brothers. Now they know my secret, too. But they don't want me to keep my promise to the Orc.

I don't know what to do.

For many years now we have been wandering between allods, from one to another, and we can't stop anywhere. Brus is long dead, but this oath weighs on me. Alas, there is no way to find Isa - to search for it, we'd need considerable supplies which we don't have.

Right now no one can promise that this attempt will not fail. We need to be better prepared.

Until now, only my brothers and I have known about our agreement with Brus. They will not reveal the secret, and I... I'm not ready to share that just yet.

A lot of time has passed since we left our island. Over the years we have discovered allods unknown to us and new peoples that we have not seen for hundreds of years.

We face a fateful decision: the Gibberlings don't have the numbers to survive alone in this new world, but we can't stay on our tiny island either. We need a new home.

The Elves have been of great help to us, although I know that they expect to get the secret of astral travel for it. Albert de Grandeur promises that the Emperor of Kania will give us one of the allods - Ingos which is in many ways similar to Isa.

Now my people are arguing - whether we should accept the offer or continue to look for Isa.

The answer has to be given soon.

I told them about Brus, leaving out the details. Few people believe the promises of the Orcs, but it seems that we have no other choice. Either we will make one last attempt to find Isa, or we will be forced to make an agreement with Kania.

They decided to give me time until the end of the year. By then, I must find Isa. If this does not happen, they will be free to make any decision.

Only one of my brothers is still alive. He stayed with his family, and I promised him that soon I would return with good news.

The team I have assembled is made up of the most determined, courageous, and foolhardy sailors. We'll either find Isa or die trying!

We have been sailing through the Astral for many months now. The Elven works they kindly shared with us proved very useful. True, none of them had been where we are right now - the Astral destroys everything it touches. If it weren't for the secret that Sven had discovered, our ship would have melted like a burning candle.

The Astral is empty - we didn't name it the Great Nothing for nothing. There is nothing here but eternal radiance, flashes of lights that can drive you crazy, and lightning bolts on the horizon. We float at the will of astral currents and winds - there are no other ways to move here. Oars can't do anything.

Fortunately, over the years we have learned to navigate it. The winds here work almost the same as in the open sea which no longer exists. And the magic device that Albert de Grander gave me allows me to trace the contours of the map.

Brus promised that my runic magic compass - a Vegvisir sprinkled with his blood - would lead me to his distant relative, Skulnar, and Isa. In return, I had to hand over the Vegvisir with the blood to the leader himself. If Rodogor's and Brus's theory is correct, this magic of theirs will help establish a connection between Skulnar and his descendants, and then bring the leader of the Northwind clan into the outside world.

Alas, it looks like the Orc made a mistake somewhere. We were running out of time. If we don't find Isa in the next few days, we'll have to turn back home.

I couldn't believe my ears when the crew told me they saw an island with a huge tree ahead. Is it Isa? The Astral can be deceptive - it shows mirages and false visions, so you can't trust your eyes. But we won't get another opportunity - we are heading for this land.

On our home island many believed that Isa had survived. If they were right, then we would be the first to set foot on the lands of Isa after Yok.

Of course, the matter of our agreement with Brus remains. I intend to fulfill it. After all, without Vegvisir I wouldn't have been able to find the way. The Orcs are not a threat now. Without their Great Mage, they will not be able to create a new Horde. Even with a commander like Skulnar the Northwind.

We've been wrecked. It's not easy to moor when the astral winds turn into a real storm. At the last moment, we were thrown onto one of the local mountains. Now the Freya, it seems, is forever chained to this peak.

Unfortunately, we lost a few people. It's also terribly cold here in the mountains. We can no longer stay put. We should try to find the Gibberlings that should still be on Isa. Before we fell, I think I saw a city.

I'm sure the local Gibberlings will help us, so we need to get out even if it's difficult.

Well, we managed to reach the city - Skalgard, one of the few settlements that still remain on Isa. My people managed to survive Yok, albeit at great cost. I met the legendary Thread Keepers or, putting it simply, the Spinners. We talked for a long time while I recounted everything I know. I told them how our small settlement survived in the midst of the Great Nothing, how Sven discovered a way to travel in the Astral, how we found other peoples.

The Thread Keepers, thanks to what they learned from me and with the help of the Ash Tree, looked into the darkness of the past. But also into the darkness of the future, knowing what will happen now that I have found Isa. They promised to think and give an answer the next day.

The Thread Keepers told me what they saw in the future. According to the prophecy, Isa would have been discovered and drawn into the war between the League and the Empire. In the fight for the power of the Ash Tree, the two great states would destroy it, thereby dooming the remnant of Isa sustained by the Great Tree.

In addition, the return of Skulnar also promises great trouble. The Spinners say that when the Orc chief returns to the Horde, he will be able to get a Great Mage to serve him. Together, Skulnar and the Great Mage will start a new Great Feast. In the end, they will conquer the whole world, enslaving the rest of the free peoples. Such is the Orcs' destiny if Skulnar returns.

I took time to think. I have a difficult decision to make.

I renounced my oath to the old shaman. Instead, I decided to help the Thread Keepers imprison the malevolent soul of Skulnar - time after time, this Orc leader returns in the guise of the Urun - one of the subspecies of the Priden people. He did much harm to my people, so even a broken oath does not weigh on my conscience that much.

Together, we decided to use my Vegvisir to reach Skulnar's soul through the blood connection and ensnare it.

This ritual is extremely dangerous. I don't know if we can survive it. But this is the least I can do for the Gibberlings on Isa, since my arrival has brought with it the threat the Thread Keepers speak of.

We were successful - with my help, the Keepers of the Thread were able to capture the spirit of Skulnar. Now he is imprisoned in an ice cave on the very shore of the island. If Fate wills it, he will remain there forever. Vegvisir has been destroyed, so no one else will be able to find Isa... At least I hope so.

However, the Thread Keepers say that I am the problem now. Other Gibberlings have seen me - and they ask questions, expecting an explanation. They want to know who I am and where I came from. But knowledge of the outside world may encourage them to look for ways to get off Isa. Such temptation will not be tolerated!

The Thread Keepers say there is a better way to keep Isa safe. To do this, they need to break all the Threads that could lead someone from the outside world to Isa. Including those Threads that connect me to my brother and his offspring. Most likely, this will kill me, but there seems to be no other way. Isa is too precious to be sacrificed.

Despite the broken Threads that connected me to my family and brother, I survived - albeit almost miraculously. I have never felt so sad and lonely. But this sacrifice is necessary for the sake of Isa. Now everyone will think that I died without achieving my goal. But I'm warmed by the knowledge that I did it. I have lived a long life, I have seen a lot, so I'm glad I will end my days here, on the homeland of my people.

At the urging of the Thread Keeper, I leave Skalgard. I will go far from the inhabited lands to where only Werebears and the remaining Urun live. No one will know where the nameless exile came from, but my appearance will not raise questions.

I settled in this cave, and although I'm capable of procuring supplies for myself, life is still very harsh here. It's extremely cold, and on top of everything else it's hard to be alone when there is no one to talk to.

I need to learn how to communicate with the local Zvergs who, apparently, are already used to me and treat me as a familiar part of the environment. If I can establish regular contact with them, then it will be much easier for me - I can exchange what I have for what they have.

Very interesting. I thought I would never meet another Gibberling again, and yet such a meeting took place. One of the brave huntresses who had been chasing a beast day and night came across my shelter. Her name is Frigga, and I think it's a funny coincidence.

Frigga is incredibly brave: Isa is too crowded for her, so she wants to explore all of it. I didn't tell her my whole story, but she is still interested in how I survive here in the wilderness. I gave here some of my supplies. She has gone back to Skalgard, but it looks like she might return. This makes sense - prey is abundant in the local wilderness.

Frigga decided to stay with me. We have seen each other many times, and each time she comes, she spends more and more time with me. She says it must be fate, and I don’t feel like arguing. Perhaps she is right.

Life here is hard, of course, but now it will be easier. The experienced hunter is not afraid of difficulties.

And one more thing - Frigga says she is with children. This is good news.

We have a daughter. One, not three. This is rather unusual for us Gibberlings, and as a rule, the birth of just one portends misfortune. Perhaps it's true. Nevertheless, I'm very happy. So is Frigga.

She suggests that it was probably a consequence of the Thread Keepers' ritual that severed the connection between me and my family. Which is a pity. I would have preferred this sacrifice to be only mine, not my entire family's. But what can we do now? We can love her the way she is.

We've made a tough decision. Driva must grow up surrounded by her kindred. The way Frigga and I grew up. It won't be easy for her to be alone, and it's another reason not to deprive her of other Gibberlings' company. Therefore, we will take her to Skalgard. She'll be safe there, and that's all that matters.

But I would like to give her something to remember us by. I asked Brock, one of my Zverg friends, to make an amulet for her. I took a bit of the meteorite that held my ship in the astral plane. I hope it will become a family heirloom that will be passed down through generations of my descendants. It's the least I could do.

Frigga took Driva to Skalgard and gave her to the Thread Keepers. They set a condition... However, I won't say what it is. Perhaps someday later, I will write about it, but now I'm too disturbed and upset. Someday I will make sense of everything and write it all down in detail. But not right now.

Frigga and I are sad, but we are still happy for our daughter. What matters is she's happy. Everything else is unimportant.

There is something I have wanted to talk about for a long time. The secret I have been silent about for many years now burns me from the inside. I no longer want to keep it. By entrusting it to paper, hopefully I will make this burden lighter.

If the Thread of my kind here is connected to the Thread of my brother's family in the outside world, Isa can be returned to that world. Without this, any search for it in the astral plane will be fruitless. Whoever searches for it will find nothing.

But if the two Threads are reconnected, our descendants will once again be bound by the ancient oath that calls for the return of the Orc leader. And the return of Isa means he will be freed. And then the prophecy about the Horde that will conquer the whole world will be fulfilled.

I have very little strength left. This is probably my last entry in the journal. Everything comes to an end, and the Thread of my Fate must also be broken. I will go on an eternal journey. Once upon a time, I went on an adventure...

From the darkness of centuries, a story is passed down - once our land was barren and empty - endless darkness dispersed only by fiery mountains among the icy deserts. And dragons reigned in this darkness. They were immortal and almost omnipotent.

But one day a ball of fire tore through the heavens. It fell on the earth and split it. And the dragons also fell, soaking that land with their blood. And he was born from that blood - Num, the creator of the living, and with him the First Spirits. But an island also rose from the melted waters, and the first of the Great Trees grew on the island. Ash!

The Ash Tree allows you to see your destiny. The first Gibberlings, Ase and Emla, were also woven from Ash branches. Emla was also the first Thread Keeper, and she inherited this prophetic gift from Ash, and from her - all her descendants.

In the beginning there were two Gibberlings - Ase and Emla, and at the dawn of time, when Emla carried her first children under her heart, she put her hair into a braid. On the same night, babies were born, and the Threads of their Fates were connected to each other in a braid. Emla saw how strong this connection made the children, and henceforth she always put her long hair in many braids, and she and Ase had many sprouts, and they were all strong in their unity.

Each Gibberling in a sprout has its own Thread, and the Threads of the sprout are tightly intertwined. This makes the sprout strong, like a bunch of twigs that is harder to break than each twig individually. However, if one of the Threads of the sprout breaks, the other two also become weaker. Therefore, the families of our people always try to stick together and protect each other.

Woe to the family where a loner is born - this is a bad omen for the future Gibberling. Innumerable troubles will haunt them, their undertakings will be unsuccessful, they will be alone in this world, bringing grief to it, and only family care will save them from imminent death. That is why our people, despite settling around the world, always return to their roots - to Skalgard.

I'm sorry about those who threw your friend into the pit. They should have remembered who the Pridens were, even though we haven't seen them in a thousand years.

The Urun and Pridens are similar in many ways. The thing is, we were divided once - the Prides were led by the Voices, and the mad and cruel Urun were tyrants. Over the centuries of separation, they have become unlike each other! When Isa split, one of the most cruel renegade tribes, the white Urun Pridens, were trapped on the allod with us. Clashes between our peoples continued for centuries, and the Urun in their strength, cruelty and deceit surpassed even the Orcs of the past.

We are grateful to true Pridens. It was with their help that a great army was once created that drove the Orcs from Isa. Those Orcs were invaders who came from distant golden lands on ships. They tried to subjugate Isa for many centuries. But our great leaders - Thorri, Lok and Wald managed to unite the Gibberlings, Pridens, Heidruns, Zvergs and other peoples of Isa, and then finally defeated the Orcs.

And then the great Yok came - the sky rolled up like a scroll, the earth's crust cracked, and the waters of the oceans evaporated. The Great Void was advancing, and only the lands around the Ash Tree were untouched by it. At the time, many Gibberlings remained on Isa - but even more of them were outside it. Clans and families were separated...

We could only assume that if Isa survived thanks to the Ash Tree, then some other lands could have also remained intact. After all, human witch-doctors once took the seeds of Ash with them, and they sprouted in other parts.

But for a thousand years of loneliness on Isa, only three large clans survived. They sheltered the last representatives of the smaller clans. And the clans now carefully monitor the interweaving of the Threads of their bloodlines in order to prevent the degeneration of their people or the overpopulation on the island!

About a hundred and ten years ago, the spawn of the Void came - disgusting creatures who wanted to destroy the Ash! But hardened by centuries of battle with the Orcs, and then with the Urun, we managed to survive the Darkest Night and protect our allies. Many clans ceased to exist, but the demons also took many of the Urun. Our warriors managed to drive the remnants of their tribe into deep abandoned caves, the burrows of an ancient snake that once lived in the roots of the Ash Tree. There, in the darkness and hunger, they harbored anger for a long time and waited for their chance...

The Uruns... Some time ago they attacked us for the first time. Their army attacked Skalgard. They were led by a mighty leader, Kharyskhan...

The times of fierce battles returned to Isa, and blood colored the snow under the Great Ash Tree again. The name of Kharyskhan was tightly woven into the Pattern on the annalistic carpet by the hands of the Thread Keepers. For this sinister leader of the Uruns constantly returned in a new guise. Every child knew his name.

But we found a solution - at the cost of huge losses, our heroes lured Kharyskhan into a trap and imprisoned his soul in a crystal of eternal ice. The crystal was hidden in a cave on the edge of our island, and the cave was sealed and disguised!
